text: This report will provide an update to the Board of Management on the cybersecurity incident that affected the Toronto Zoo in January 2024. This report appends a privileged and confidential report that summarizes the results of the investigation into the cause of the attack.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (May 17, 2024) from the Director, Finance, Technology and Innovation for information. 2. Directed that the privileged and confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 17, 2024) from the Director, Finance, Technology and Innovation remain confidential in its entirety, as it is advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
